items.title: Ad network
clues: I sit between many publishers and many advertisers.
I buy bulk ad space and resell it.
I keep a margin between what I pay and what I charge.
Run of network is one way to buy from me.
items.why: A network aggregates inventory from publishers and sells it to advertisers.

items.title: Blind network
clues: Advertisers buy reach cheaply from me.
I may not tell advertisers which sites the ad ran on.
My name says something cannot be seen.
items.why: On a blind network the buyer cannot choose or see the sites.

items.title: Margin
clues: I am a difference between two prices.
Buy low from publishers and sell high to advertisers.
items.why: The margin is the gap between what the network charges and what it pays the publisher.
